title: BREAKING: Police Searching for Suspect After Officer Involved Shooting in Santa Monica - NewsBreak
text: SANTA MONICA - An officer was injured Wednesday in a shooting in Santa Monica, prompting a search for a suspect at the Santa Monica Place Mall.Santa Monica Police issued an alert around 1:30 p.m., urging the public to avoid Fourth Street and Colorado Avenue, where the mall is located.Officers were conducting a coordinated search for the suspect, according to department spokesman Lt. Lewis Gilmour.It was not immediately clear if the officer, who was taken to a hospital for treatment, was struck by gunfire.Santa Monica Mayor Lana Negrete addressed growing public concern, particularly from families with children enrolled in local activities."I understand many parents are concerned about their children participating in sports at Samo and other camps and summer activity happening nearby," said Negrete. "I've received lots of texts and calls and wanted to let everyone know I've been in communication with our superintendent, and a lockdown is in place for safety.""Please practice caution by staying indoors and avoiding downtown," she added. "We are working with all partners in the area to make sure parks and schools, as well as businesses and anyone in the area, are safe."
